headline: AMD Stock Slides After Solid  Earnings. The Chip Maker Has a Bigger Problem.
summary: Advanced Micro Devices reported solid but unspectacular second-quarter earnings and its shares were falling more than 8% ahead of the open of trading Wednesday. Adjusted operating income reached $3.1 billion, with a 27% operating margin, just above the Wall Street consensus estimate.
